moral.zh: 热空气膨胀后密度变小，外面的冷空气浮力足够大时，热气球就会上升。
moral.en: Warm air is less dense; when outside air provides enough buoyancy, a hot-air balloon can rise.

pages.enText: At the hot-air balloon festival, Yu looks up and asks, “Why can it fly?”
